headline: Toyota Industries Corporation -- Moody's confirms Toyota Industries' A2 ratings; outlook negative
summary: Moody's Japan K.K. has today confirmed Toyota Industries Corporation's (TICO) A2 issuer and senior unsecured ratings. The rating outlook is changed to negative from rating under review. This action was primarily prompted by Moody's decision to confirm Toyota Motor Corporation's (TMC) A1 long-term ratings with a negative outlook, as announced on 27 May 2020.
